== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Council of Architects]] serves as the governing body for the [[Consultant's Guild]]. Comprised of a diverse group of specialists including administrators, strategists, [[Alchemists|alchemists]], and [[Readers]], the Council is composed of individuals with highly valuable talents. While many [[Architects]] deliberate in anonymous, shadowed alcoves, the three High [[Councilors]] act as the public voice for the [[Am’haranai]] and represent the [[Guild]] during negotiations with other organizations. The Council's primary meeting place is an underground chamber on [[Gray Island]], featuring a ceiling of soil and tree roots held together by alchemy or [[Reading]]. Within this chamber, the High [[Councilors]] gather around an ancient, chalk-like column that functions as a table. This artifact, created by early Empire [[Alchemists|alchemists]] and [[Readers]], can be used to display glowing yellow light when sketched upon. The Council was established through an election following the death of the last [[Soulbound]] at [[Bastion's Veil]]. Although the Mistress or Master of the Mists holds the [[Authority|authority]] to supersede the Council, the group has functioned as the primary leadership for many generations. The High Council makes critical decisions regarding the [[Guild]]'s direction, such as determining which tasks fall to specific roles like the [[Gardeners]] or managing relations with [[The Empire|the Empire]].}}
